question: Is a garland of jātī and yūthī flowers faulty when made entirely white?
premises: A garland may be made of jātī and yūthī flowers.
The garland may be entirely white.
Such an entirely white garland is declared faulty.
inference: Therefore, an all-white garland of jātī and yūthī is not acceptable.
plain_english: A garland made of jātī and yūthī flowers is faulty if it is entirely white.
